pricing_quoted_from_https_www_football_d.Free + Deep Data: EUR 29 / 12 comps / lineups, goal scorers, cards, squads
pricing_quoted_from_https_www_football_d.Statistic Add-On: EUR 15 — "corners, free-kicks, offsides, fouls, ball possession, saves, shots on/off goal, cards"
pricing_quoted_from_https_www_football_d.note: "Add-Ons can only be booked on top of a regular subscription plan."

assessment.all_four_leagues: YES but not on one cheap tier: EPL + La Liga are Tier 1 (free); MLS needs Tier 2 (EUR 49); Liga MX needs Tier 3 (EUR 99). Cheapest plan covering all four = Advanced EUR 99/mo.
assessment.season_visibility_2026_27: PROVEN present in the unauthenticated catalogue: EPL 2026-08-21..2027-05-30, La Liga 2026-08-16..2027-05-30, MLS 2026 currentMatchday 18, Liga MX Apertura 2026-07-17..2026-11-23 currentMatchday 3
assessment.per_fixture_team_stats: YES via the EUR 15 Statistic Add-On (shots on/off target, corners, possession, fouls, cards). No shot locations.
assessment.per_player_match_stats: NO — deep data is lineups, goal scorers, cards, squads. No per-player shots/passes/minutes stat lines.
assessment.xg: ABSENT. xG appears nowhere in the pricing page, the Statistic Add-On field list, or the coverage table.
assessment.identity: stable integer competition/team/match ids (e.g. Premier League = 2021, Liga MX = 2113). No ESPN cross-reference field.
assessment.cost_at_this_volume: EUR 99 Advanced + EUR 15 Statistic Add-On = EUR 114/mo = EUR 1368/yr
assessment.fails: criterion 2 (no per-player match stats) and criterion 3 (no xG at all) — which is the whole reason for buying
